### [`unused_ff80`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_ff80.asm#L6) `$FF80-$FFF9`

*data*

Nothing reads $ff80-$fff9. All these bytes are 0. Build V 05 05 87 has the $00/$ff RAM fill pattern at $ff80-$ffef.
